messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Pacify Health sent a bulleted list of asks after onboarding call. want to capture here and triage into product vs docs vs enablement. short thread so we can snapshot for QBR.
Ethan Wright: thanks — can you paste the list? I'll do initial triage and tag owners.
Maya Patel: sure, pasted below (copied from CS notes):
```
- Improve per-route cost visibility (customers want per-endpoint breakdown)
- Exportable onboarding checklist (PDF/CSV) for compliance teams
- Faster token-usage alerts (threshold + daily digest)
- Example prompts for regulated data redaction
- Option to pin model version per-route in Dedicated
```
Priya Rao: quick reactions: 1 = product, 2 = docs + PD, 3 = infra/alerts (could be short-term via console), 4 = enablement + templates, 5 = product + sales for comms
Jordan Lee: re 3 (token alerts) — we can prototype a daily digest email from current telemetry in ~1 sprint if we add a small webhook. tagging @eng-infra
Ethan Wright: noted. I'll create GitHub issues: product backlog for 1 and 5, docs ticket for 2, infra spike for 3, and enablement task for 4. anyone object?
Maya Patel: no objections. add renewal-risk flag for Pacify Health (they mentioned billing opacity as a deciding factor). put "high" in the issue labels.
Priya Rao: small ask — can we include example language for customer-facing comms in the enablement ticket? Pacify wants to share the checklist with auditors.
Jordan Lee: yes — I'll draft a short template.
Ethan Wright: creating issues now. will post links when done.
reminder-bot: Don’t forget — weekly triage sync in #customer-success tomorrow 10:00am. :bell:
Maya Patel: thanks team. once issues exist, can we prioritize 1 and 5 for next planning cycle? those directly affect renewal risk.
Ethan Wright: agree. marking both as priority-P1 on the backlog draft. will include estimated effort in the issue description.
Priya Rao: I'll coordinate the enablement draft and pair with Jordan for the audit wording.
Maya Patel: perfect. tagging @product for visibility. will paste issue links here when Ethan posts them. :thumbsup:
